risk_summary: The disclosure presents meaningful operating pressure from San Francisco market conditions, reduced business travel, renovation-related room outages, and continued net losses. It provides useful quantitative operating and financial data, but relies substantially on subjective macroeconomic and social explanations and emphasizes adjusted or hypothetical performance measures. Significant estimation uncertainty remains around tax asset recoverability and long-lived asset impairment.
